mapper.insert: INSERT INTO assessment_record ( assessment_type, dept, shift, person, assessment_date, content, opinion, remark, trainer, rectify_result, rectify_status, checker, leader, photo_urls, extra2, extra3, creator ) VALUES ( #{assessmentType}, #{dept}, #{shift}, #{person}, #{assessmentDate}, #{content}, #{opinion}, #{remark}, #{trainer}, #{rectifyResult}, #{rectifyStatus}, #{checker}, #{leader}, #{photoUrls, typeHandler=com.office.yancao.untils.JsonListTypeHandler}, #{extra2}, #{extra3}, #{creator} )
